## Context
Noolbenger RCA found that a Gerrit object-store repair fetched the stale GitHub mirror directly into Gerrit branch refs (`+refs/heads/*:refs/heads/*`), moving `refs/heads/main` backward while Gerrit NoteDb still marked later changes MERGED.

## Plan
1. Update `infra/runbooks/gerrit-object-store-repair.md` so repair fetches import objects only into a concrete quarantine namespace, `refs/recovery/github/*`, never directly into `refs/heads/*` or other live refs.
2. Put the guard in the operator path: add `infra/scripts/validate-gerrit-repair-refspecs.sh` and have the runbook require operators to run it immediately before any manual mirror-recovery `git fetch`. The guard hard-rejects refspecs whose destination is `refs/heads/*`; warning-only behavior is not acceptable for protected branch refs.
3. Extend `tests/scripts/test_gerrit_object_store_repair.py`, the existing content contract for this runbook, with assertions for the quarantine namespace, forbidden direct-branch refspec, required pre/post checklist items, and guard behavior.
4. Include pre/post checks in the runbook: EBS snapshot before mutation, record expected old/new main SHAs, fetch quarantine refs, verify named objects plus `refs/heads`, `refs/tags`, `refs/changes`, and `refs/meta`, run `git fsck --full --connectivity-only --no-dangling --strict`, trigger replication, run Mirror Guard merged-reachability, and only then retire the quarantine namespace.
5. Verify locally with the RED test first, then targeted tests and `make verify PYTEST_WORKERS=2`; land through Gerrit and close after both gates pass.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] The runbook names `refs/recovery/github/*` as the quarantine namespace for mirror-recovery imports.
- [x] The runbook contains no repair refspec that writes mirror refs directly to `refs/heads/*`.
- [x] The runbook requires `infra/scripts/validate-gerrit-repair-refspecs.sh` before any manual mirror-recovery `git fetch`.
- [x] The guard hard-rejects the known-bad refspec `+refs/heads/*:refs/heads/*`.
- [x] The guard hard-rejects any refspec whose destination is `refs/heads/*`.
- [x] The guard permits a quarantine refspec such as `refs/heads/main:refs/recovery/github/main`.
- [x] `tests/scripts/test_gerrit_object_store_repair.py` asserts the runbook quarantine namespace and checklist contract.
- [x] `tests/scripts/test_gerrit_object_store_repair.py` asserts guard reject/allow behavior.
- [x] The runbook checklist includes an EBS snapshot before mutation.
- [x] The runbook checklist includes recording expected old/new main SHAs before and after repair.
- [x] The runbook checklist includes verifying `refs/changes` and `refs/meta` reachability.
- [x] The runbook checklist includes `git fsck --full --connectivity-only --no-dangling --strict`.
- [x] The runbook checklist includes triggering Gerrit-to-GitHub replication after repair.
- [x] The runbook checklist includes running Mirror Guard merged-reachability after repair.
- [x] The runbook checklist includes retiring `refs/recovery/github/*` only after verification succeeds, or deleting it on abort.
- [x] The runbook links the repair checklist to the Mirror Guard merged-reachability invariant added during noolbenger.
- [x] `make verify PYTEST_WORKERS=2` passes before Gerrit review.
